# Agent button icons

- Claude: reused from `public/logos/agents/claude.svg` in this repository.
- Codex: reused OpenAI mark from `public/logos/agents/openai.svg`, as used by the earlier onboarding button.
- Pi: official compact badge, downloaded from https://pi.dev/favicon.svg; listed in https://pi.dev/press-kit.

The onboarding picker retains the original client icon colors. The source SVGs are unmodified.

The secondary GitHub button uses the repository's existing Lucide GitHub icon geometry (lucide-react, ISC license).

The OpenCode route and tab use the Lucide Terminal icon (ISC license), a generic terminal symbol rather than an OpenCode brand mark.

The onboarding picker reuses the Console client icons: `codex-app.png`, `claude-app.png`, `codex-cli.svg`, and `claude-code-cli.svg`, copied unchanged from `agentrun-product-preview/parcha-fe/public/images/marketing/logos/mcp/`. Cursor and terminal choices use Lucide-style pointer/terminal geometry (ISC license).
